negative_intelligence.evidence: Corroborated by stateroom stewards and field acoustic audits during 2024/2025 Mediterranean sailings.
negative_intelligence.impact: Cabins directly below Marketplace Buffet (Deck 15 Aft, especially cabins 14200 to 14280) experience early morning cart rolling and deck washing vibrations between 05:30 and 07:00.
negative_intelligence.mitigation: Select staterooms between Deck 9 and Deck 12 buffered by residential staterooms both above and below (e.g. Deck 11 Caravaggio or Deck 12 Giotto).
negative_intelligence.title: Overhead Trolley & Cleaning Noise on Deck 14 Aft

negative_intelligence.evidence: Measured 11.4 min peak queue at Deck 6 Galleria landing during Gala Night show exit.
negative_intelligence.impact: The central panoramic lifts flanking the Galleria suffer 8-12 minute wait times immediately preceding the first and second seating theatre shows.
negative_intelligence.mitigation: Use the Forward or Aft vertical stairwell banks, or board the forward express elevators located 40m forward of the central atrium.
negative_intelligence.title: Midship Panoramic Elevator Bottleneck at 19:30 & 21:15

negative_intelligence.evidence: MSC Cruises Guest Information Directive & ITU Maritime Telecommunication Standards.
negative_intelligence.impact: Phones connecting to 'CellularAtSea' or 'TIM Maritime' satellite networks outside 12 nautical miles incur standard carrier charges of €6-€15 per megabyte.
negative_intelligence.mitigation: Engage Airplane Mode prior to vessel cast-off from port quayside and enable Wi-Fi calling over the shipboard Starlink package.
negative_intelligence.title: Cellular At Sea Satellite Roaming Expense

negative_intelligence.evidence: Verified from Chantiers de l'Atlantique General Arrangement drawing Frame 120-180.
negative_intelligence.impact: Outer balcony staterooms 8060 to 8120 overlook the fiberglass hulls of the 150-person survival craft suspended directly at rail level.
negative_intelligence.mitigation: Book staterooms on Deck 9 Botticelli or higher, or choose Category B2/B3 Deluxe Balcony for uninterrupted 180-degree ocean horizon.
negative_intelligence.title: Lifeboat Tender Davit Obstruction on Deck 8 Promenade Staterooms
